name: Toast
description: Props for the Toast host component.

parts.name: Toast
parts.description: Props for the Toast host component.

props.name: class
props.description: Class applied to the component root or trigger element.

props.name: classes
props.description: Family slot class defaults for this instance.

props.name: close
props.description: Close button configuration or custom JSX element. When truthy, enables closing.

props.name: duration
props.description: Default duration before auto-close in milliseconds.

props.name: expand
props.description: Whether to expand the stacked toast list by default.

props.name: gap
props.description: Gap between toasts in pixels when expanded.

props.name: id
props.description: Match toasts targeting a specific Toast host identifier.

props.name: invert
props.description: Whether to invert colors (e.g. dark toast on light theme).

props.name: itemRender
props.description: Custom renderer for individual toast items.

props.name: large
props.description: Whether to use large multi-line layout.

props.name: placement
props.description: Vertical stack placement on the viewport.

props.name: preventDuplicate
props.description:
Prevent duplicate toasts with matching content.
Can be a boolean or a custom predicate comparing candidate against the front toast.

props.name: showProgress
props.description: Whether to show the remaining duration progress bar.

props.name: store
props.description: Isolated store rendered by this host. Defaults to the shared `Toast.*` store.

props.name: style
props.description: Style applied to the component root or trigger element.

props.name: styles
props.description: Family slot style defaults for this instance.

props.name: visibleToasts
props.description: Max number of simultaneously visible toasts in a stack.
